notes: γε left unrepresented on the English-side test rules 65 and 70 apply to an intensifying particle: the ASV writes one word and it answers to the inferential ἄρα. Joining ἄρα γε into a single unit on 'Therefore' remains defensible.

εἰπόντος keeps the supplied subordinator and the supplied subject of the genitive absolute (rules 74, 86); the article before ἀλλοτρίων is unrepresented for want of an English determiner, as at MAT.17.25 (rule 24).
εἰσιν is expressed, so the predicate adjective ἐλεύθεροι takes only 'free' and no supplied-copula question arises.
